The '''NA LCS 2018 Spring Split''' was the first franchised split of the [[North American League of Legends Championship Series]], organized by Riot Games. It ran from January 20 to April 8, 2018, with the Regular Season held in Los Angeles, United States, and the Playoffs in Miami, United States. Ten permanent partner teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Group Stage, followed by a Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoff bracket. The total prize pool was $200,000 USD.The top three teams from the Playoffs qualified for the [[Rift Rivals/NA-EU/2018|2018 Rift Rivals]] tournament against the [[EU LCS]], and the Spring champion qualified for the [[Mid Season Invitational/2018|2018 Mid-Season Invitational]]. 

This split marked the launch of the NA LCS franchising system, replacing relegation with permanent league slots. Teams will be selected from an application process and no longer have to face relegation or the promotion tournament. Additionally, the Challenger Series will be rebooted as an Academy League, where each NA LCS organization will field a team of developmental players. 

''See [[NA LCS Franchising]] for further details.''
